subject: Request: pilot onboarding & invoice-only (no PO) for Catalyst Labs

To: kimberly.park@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@catalystlabs.io
Date: Fri, 9 Oct 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot onboarding request — invoice-only for 6-week trial

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for the demo yesterday — the team and I are excited about Redwood's latency and batching controls. We'd like to run a small 6-week proof-of-concept (pilot) with a single project, estimated usage ~USD 1.5k–2k total. Our procurement team has a strict PO workflow for multi-month commitments, but for short pilots they allow invoice-only arrangements if the vendor agrees and finance signs an exception.

Can Redwood accept invoice-only billing (no PO) for this pilot? If yes, please let me know what evidence you need (W-9, invoice cadence, SOW). I can attach our standard pilot MOA and W-9 — attaching now.

Attachments: pilot-MOA.pdf (Catalyst Labs — pilot statement of work), Catalyst_W-9.pdf

Appreciate a quick read — we aim to start the week of Oct 19.

Best,
Liam
Head of Integrations
Catalyst Labs

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 9 Oct 2026 14:38:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot onboarding request — invoice-only for 6-week trial

Thanks for the ping — quick procurement checklist for a temporary invoice-only exception:

- Signed pilot MOA (we have the attachment from Catalyst).
- W-9 / tax form (attached).
- Billing contact + remit address (we need to confirm).
- Purchase cap and approval window (recommend: cap at $10,000 and 60 days from invoice date).
- Business justification note and sponsor (Kimberly / Sales).
- Minimal security attestation (are they storing PII? if yes, ask for SOC2 report or security snapshot).

Per policy: we can approve invoice-only for pilots <= $10k with Procurement + Finance approval. That approval should include: invoice cadence (net30 preferred), billing contact, and an agreed end date for the exception. I'll draft an exception memo once Finance gives OK.

Kimberly — can you confirm the billing contact and whether Catalyst will store any customer data during the pilot? Liam: can you confirm those two items so we can process quickly?

-- Marissa
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com, kimberly.park@redwood.com, priyom.das@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 9 Oct 2026 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot onboarding request — invoice-only for 6-week trial

I reviewed. Finance is comfortable granting a temporary PO-exemption for this pilot under these constraints:

- Cap: $10,000 total.
- Exception window: single invoice covering the pilot, due Net30.
- Exception expires 90 days from approval if no subsequent PO is raised.
- Requirements to execute exception: signed MOA, W-9, billing/remit address, Redwood deal ID on invoice.
- No PII storage during pilot (if Catalyst needs to ingest customer data, Procurement must collect SOC2 / security summary before exception).

If Procurement drafts the memo, I will sign off. Priyom — please capture this in the HubSpot deal and notify CS for onboarding coordination.

Karthik
Head of Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
